objections.about: The customer calls this a Blotato bug and tells staff to fix it. The reply decides on its own that it is an intentional guardrail, and a team member should make that call.

The reply says the cap is Blotato's own and not Instagram's, but the error the customer saw says 'Instagram allows a maximum of 5 hashtags'. The reply also gives a reason for the cap, reduced reach on Instagram, TikTok and Facebook, that it can't back up and that doesn't explain the error.
